column1: # Declarative manifest of `defaults`-managed app + macOS system preferences.
# Consumed by `make backup` (defaults export) and scripts/restore-apps.sh
# The optional fourth field defaults to the label. Use `-` for macOS domains
# that have no owning application process.
# Plist paths are repo-root-relative; variable placeholders are not expanded.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
# NOTE: apps needing container copies / exclusions / sanitize steps (Dato,
# Sublime Text, VS Code, Cursor, Zed settings/keymaps) stay as explicit blocks in their consumers — they carry
# irregular logic that does not fit a flat row. This manifest is for the
# macOS system UX domains — too deeply nested to hand-write in macos/defaults.sh,
# so snapshotted whole. Plists live in macos/ (next to dock-backup.plist), not
# apps/. Changes need a logout (or killall cfprefsd) to take effect on import.
# Shottr license prefs (kc-license) — vault via make backup-shottr / restore-shottr.
# Monokai Pro license settings are NOT kept in the repo — vault only
